_comment: Acceptance-environment test data. Spec terminology: cashout = collection (money OUT of customer wallet), cashin = disbursement (money INTO recipient wallet). Copy this file to smoke-test.json (which is gitignored) and fill in baseUrl, publicKey, secretKey. Set any per-flow block to null (or remove it) to skip that scenario. The Java and Node.js clients' smoke-test.json schema is drop-in compatible with this Go runner.
_collect_comment: By default every collection scenario stops at the quote — the harness never calls /v2/collectstd. To exercise a real collect on a given flow, add the following keys to that block: "collect": true, "customerPhonenumber": "<payer/recipient MSISDN>", "customerEmailaddress": "<receipt email>". For services with isReqServiceNumber=true (e.g. CMMTNMOMO Cash-In), also set "serviceNumber". Other optional pass-through fields: customerName, customerAddress, customerNumber, trid (auto-generated otherwise), tag, callbackUrl, cdata. WARNING: opting in moves real money on the partner balance.

_collect_example._comment: Worked example — copy these keys into the cashin block to disburse 1000 XAF to MSISDN 699999999 via CMORANGEMOMO. Tested 2026-05-27.

cashout._comment: Collection — money flows OUT of customer wallet. Currently: CMMTNMOMO Cash-Out / Depot (row 20).

topup._comment: TOPUP airtime. Row 12: CMMTN serviceId 20051. Other options: row 13 CMORANGE (20062), row 9 CMCamtel (20101).

voucher._comment: VOUCHER. Discovered from the scenarioServices 'VOUCHER services:' line: serviceId=90041 (ENEO PREPAID).

subscription._comment: SUBSCRIPTION. ENEO prepaid (serviceId 300924). Merchant code 'ENEOPREPAID300924'. The API rejects sending both serviceNumber AND customerNumber (respCode 4107). amount is provided because ENEO PREPAID is a custom-amount subscription (catalog amountLocalCur=0.0).

cashin._comment: Disbursement — money flows INTO recipient wallet. Switched from CMMTNMOMO Cash-In (serviceId 20052 / MSISDN 677389120) because 677389120 is server-blocked on acceptance (respCode 40305). Now on CMORANGEMOMO Cash-In (serviceId 50052 / MSISDN 699999999) — verified live 2026-05-27 with a successful collect. Other wiki options: row 17 CMORANGEOM Cash-In (30052 / 697707102), row 21 CMYOOMEEMONEY Cashin (100237 / 242254751). To exercise a real /v2/collectstd, set the collect/customerPhonenumber/customerEmailaddress/serviceNumber keys per the example at the top of this file.

verify._comment: Pre-payment serviceNumber validation. ENEO/1001 (ENEO Bills/Factures, isVerifiable=true).

validate._comment: Account validation via GET /v2/validate — returns a CustomerAccount {status, name, destination}. Status: UNKNOWN | VALIDATED (syntax only) | VERIFIED (cross-checked with provider). Sample: MTN MoMo MSISDN 677389120 against the cashout service 20053 (CMMTNMOMO Cash-Out, row 20).
